title: REALM: A Dataset of Real-World LLM Use Cases

bias_targets.methodology: Applying a debiasing analysis to normalize raw LLM use case statistics by computing the baseline discussion proportion for each occupational group to calculate an adjusted 'LLM exposure rate'.
